H7600.gloss: that is at ease, quiet, tumult. Compare H7946 (שַׁלְאֲנָן).
H7600.def: secure; in a bad sense, haughty

H7602.gloss: desire (earnestly), devour, haste, pant, snuff up, swallow up.

H7603.def: barm or yeast-cake (as swelling by fermentation)

H7604.gloss: leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest.

H7607.gloss: body, flesh, food, (near) kin(-sman, -swoman), near (nigh) (of kin).
H7607.def: flesh (as swelling out), as living or forfood; generally food of any kind; figuratively, kindred by blood

H7611.gloss: that had escaped, be left, posterity, remain(-der), remnant, residue, rest.
H7611.def: a remainder or residual (surviving, final) portion

H7613.def: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character

H7617.gloss: (bring away, carry, carry away, lead, lead away, take) captive(-s), drive (take) away.

H7618.def: a gem (from its sparkle), probably the agate

H7619.def: Shebuel or Shubael, the name of two Israelites

H7620.def: literally, sevened, i.e. a week (specifically, of years)

H7621.def: properly, something sworn, i.e. an oath

H7623.gloss: commend, glory, keep in, praise, still, triumph.

H7626.gloss: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

H7640.def: a lady's train (as trailing after her)

H7641.gloss: branch, channel, ear (of corn), (water-)flood, Shibboleth. Compare H5451 (סִבֹּלֶת).
H7641.def: a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch

H7642.def: a snail (as if floating in its own slime)

H7645.def: Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites

H7646.gloss: have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.

H7649.def: satiated (in a pleasant or disagreeable sense)

H7667.gloss: affliction, breach, breaking, broken(-footed, -handed), bruise, crashing, destruction, hurt, interpretation, vexation.

H7670.def: rupture, i.e. a pang; figuratively, ruin

H7673.gloss: (cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer to be lacking, leave, put away (down), (make to) rest, rid, still, take away.

H7674.gloss: cease, sit still, loss of time.

H7690.gloss: exceeding, great(-ly); many, much, sore, very.

H7699.def: the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging)
